items.title: Inventory every clone-local HMAC key consumer and record what each verifier does when the key is missing or regenerated
items.context: Key files: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-basis-receipt.ts (KEY_FILE), acceptance-rollout.ts (ROLLOUT_KEY_FILE, readOrCreatePrivateKey, registeredPublicKey), pre-review-check.ts (KEY_FILE), and the finding-ledger key proof-or-stop-finding-ledger-v1.key created 2026-09-01. All use writeFileSync flag 'wx' with randomBytes, so a re-clone silently creates a new key.

items.title: Add an explicit key-epoch or re-anchor marker for those ledgers, reusing the B-8d60 gap_log_chain_reanchor design where the ledger is append-only
items.context: B-8d60 decision.json option C-frozen-legacy-plus-reanchor: legacy records stay byte-frozen and structurally verified, key loss is declared in a signed epoch-boundary record, verifiers report a distinct reason instead of silently passing or failing. Refuse the marker when structural checks fail.

items.title: Doctor reports records that predate the current key with an actionable hint
items.context: proof-or-stop doctor has no check for keyed-ledger key age today (grep for 'gap-log' or 'provenance' in packages/main/src/handlers/doctor.ts returns nothing before B-8d60). Extend the B-8d60 gap-log-ledger doctor check to the sibling ledgers.
